SELECT v."RegistrationNumber", v."ChassisNumber", v."VehicleTypeModel", v."EngineNumber", v."VehicleLocation", v."Command", v."Zone", v."Condition", v."MaintenanceStatus", v."MaintenanceDueInKm", v."LastMaintenanceDate", v."CurrentMileage", v."Comments", v."PictureA", v."PictureB", v."PictureC", v."PictureD", v."PictureE", v."CreatedAt", v."Id", a."Id", a."VehicleId", a."ChassisNumber", a."OfficerName", a."OfficerSerNo", a."Type", a."Rank", a."Command", a."Zone", a."Department", a."Office", a."Unit", a."YearOfAllocation", a."CreatedAt", d."SerNo", d."Address", d."Name", d."LicenseNumber", d."PhoneNumber", d."Rank", d."CreatedAt", d."Id", r."RemarkText", r."ChassisNumber", r."VehicleId", r."UserId", r."CreatedAt", r."Id", l."Purpose", l."ReasonForRjection", l."Status", l."TimeIn", l."TimeOut", l."To", l."From", l."Created", l."OfficerCarried", l."MileageTotal", l."MileageBefore", l."MileageAfter", l."Remarks", l."Id", m."Body", m."Title", m."Created", m."Id", i."Body", i."Title", i."Created", i."Id"
FROM "VehicleAssessments" AS v
LEFT JOIN "Allocations" AS a ON v."Id" = a."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "Drivers" AS d ON v."Id" = d."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "Remarks" AS r ON v."Id" = r."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "LogBooks" AS l ON v."Id" = l."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "MaintenanceReports" AS m ON v."Id" = m."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "IncidentReports" AS i ON v."Id" = i."VehicleId"
ORDER BY v."Id", a."Id", d."Id", r."Id", l."Id", m."Id"

FROM "VehicleAssessments" AS v
LEFT JOIN "Allocations" AS a ON v."Id" = a."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "Drivers" AS d ON v."Id" = d."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "Remarks" AS r ON v."Id" = r."VehicleId"
LEFT JOIN "LogBooks" AS l ON v."Id" = l."VehicleId"

SELECT count(*)::int
FROM "SparePartRequests" AS s

SELECT t."Id", t."ApprovalRemarks", t."ApprovedByUserId", t."ApprovedDate", t."Created", t."IsUrgent", t."Priority", t."RejectionReason", t."RequestNumber", t."RequestType", t."RequiredByDate", t."Status", t."Updated", t."UserId", t."VehicleId", v."Id", v."ChassisNumber", v."Command", v."Comments", v."Condition", v."CreatedAt", v."CurrentMileage", v."EngineNumber", v."ImagePath", v."InitialMileage", v."LastMaintenanceDate", v."LastMaintenanceMileage", v."MaintenanceDueInKm", v."MaintenanceStatus", v."PictureA", v."PictureB", v."PictureC", v."PictureD", v."PictureE", v."RecommendedAction", v."RegistrationNumber", v."Remark", v."Timestamp", v."UpdatedAt", v."VehicleLocation", v."VehicleTypeModel", v."Zone", u."UserId", i."Id", i."Brand", i."Category", i."Created", i."IsCritical", i."IsStockItem", i."ItemStatus", i."PartNumber", i."QuantityApproved", i."QuantityRequested", i."SparePartRequestId", i."Specification", i."SupplierName", i."SupplierPartNumber", i."UnitOfMeasure", i."UnitPrice", i."Updated", i."UserId", i."VehicleId", u."AccessLevel", u."Command", u."DateCreated", u."Email", u."Fullname", u."LastLoginDate", u."Password", u."Phone", u."Rank", u."RefreshToken", u."RefreshTokenExpiryTime", u."Status", u."Svn", u."Zone"
FROM (
    SELECT s."Id", s."ApprovalRemarks", s."ApprovedByUserId", s."ApprovedDate", s."Created", s."IsUrgent", s."Priority", s."RejectionReason", s."RequestNumber", s."RequestType", s."RequiredByDate", s."Status", s."Updated", s."UserId", s."VehicleId"
    FROM "SparePartRequests" AS s
    ORDER BY s."Created" DESC
    LIMIT @__p_1 OFFSET @__p_0
) AS t
INNER JOIN "VehicleAssessments" AS v ON t."VehicleId" = v."Id"
LEFT JOIN "Users" AS u ON t."ApprovedByUserId" = u."UserId"
LEFT JOIN "Items" AS i ON t."Id" = i."SparePartRequestId"
ORDER BY t."Created" DESC, t."Id", v."Id", u."UserId"
